meta.title: Jungle Padel — indoor padel club in Pantelimon · Opening March 2027
meta.description: Four indoor padel courts, a lounge suspended 3 metres up between them, Reformer Pilates and a league with live rankings. Facilities designed to the highest European standards. Join the waitlist.

hero.title: Watch the game from three metres up.
hero.lead: Four indoor padel courts, a gallery lounge 3 metres up between them and a club where everything, from booking to payment, runs digitally. Facilities designed to the highest European standards.
hero.renderAlt: 3D rendering, evening: the view from the gallery lounge 3 metres up, over the glass balustrade, towards the glass-walled padel courts lit by LED lines.
hero.renderNote: Illustrative 3D rendering made by us from the club's sketch. Not a photograph and not the final design.

arena.title: Four courts. One standard.
arena.lead: Enclosed padel courts in a hall heated in winter and cooled in summer, with a sound system and lighting for matches, training and club nights.

stats.lounge: metres: height of the gallery lounge between the courts
stats.climate: seasons of play, in the climate-controlled hall

points: A gallery lounge 3 m up, between the two rows of courts
A screen at every court: players, rank and time left

ecosystem.title: From booking to leaving, no queues and no paperwork.
ecosystem.lead: One account and one digital card connect everything: booking, access, the league and payment.

steps.title: Book online
steps.text: Choose the court, time and duration, any time and as far ahead as you like.

steps.title: Get your digital card
steps.text: Your member card with a QR code arrives by email and you can keep it on your phone.

steps.title: Check in with one gesture
steps.text: Scan your card on arrival and at the court entrance. Attendance is recorded automatically.

steps.title: Play
steps.text: The court screen shows the match, the players and the time left.

steps.title: The score, confirmed by everyone
steps.text: At the league kiosk, every player scans their card and confirms the result.

steps.title: Pay or split the hour
steps.text: At the payment kiosk everyone pays their share. The fiscal receipt is issued automatically.

steps.title: Leave. It's all in your account.
steps.text: Bookings, payments, attendance and league progress, all visible in your account.

facilities.title: Everything you need, under one roof.

lockers.title: Changing rooms
lockers.text: Spaces to change, designed for comfort before and after play.

pilates.title: Reformer pilates
pilates.text: A studio in the building next door, heated and cooled: 4 Reformer machines at opening, up to 6. Classes by level, private and duo sessions.

events.title: Event room
events.text: A separate room, in the same building as the Pilates studio, for parties and private events of 15–20 people.

lounge.title: Specialty café & lounge
lounge.text: Specialty coffee on the ground floor, with stairs up to the gallery lounge above the courts.

facilities.rendersSoon: Photorealistic renderings of these spaces will be added from the architectural project.
facilities.lead: Changing rooms, a Pilates studio, an event room and a café, designed as parts of the same club.

league.title: A serious ranking. A card that shows your status.
league.lead: Every official match updates your points and rank. Seasons last 3 months and the rankings are live, online and in the club. Your member card reflects the rank you reach.
rules: Scores are entered only at the league kiosk in the club and validated only when every player confirms them.
Three ladders: doubles, singles and pairs.
A minimum number of matches per season for the final ranking: nobody reaches the top from a single match.
Reach Diamond and you receive a special physical card.
league.tierHint: Scroll or choose a tier to see the card's finish.
league.cardAlt: 3D rendering of the Jungle Padel member card with a metallic finish, in the Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond tiers.
league.cta: Sign up for the league launch
